name: How long does a typical outdated-room modernization project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical outdated-room modernization project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an outdated-room modernization project varies significantly based on the room type, the extent of the updates, and material availability. A bathroom or kitchen modernization, for instance, typically takes longer due to plumbing, electrical work, and custom cabinetry. Simpler updates like painting, new flooring, and lighting can be completed in a few days to a couple of weeks. More complex projects might extend to 4-8 weeks. To get an accurate timeline for your project, Frasheski Construction recommends scheduling an initial consultation. During this consultation, we can assess your specific needs and provide a more precise project schedule based on our experience in the Berkeley and East Bay areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary widely by room type and scope, from a few days for minor updates to 4-8 weeks for more complex modernizations like kitchens or bathrooms. A consultation provides an accurate estimate.
